name: Jackin
source:
Baby-faced rookie dealer Kai is excited to get his first job as a card dealer at a cruise ship's VIP casino.

Then he learns about their special house rule, "One Night Jack": if a player beats the dealer in a card game, the dealer has to spend the night with him.

The more experienced dealer Joe promises to take Kai under his wing -- but will Kai just end up becoming his toy?
